scope: Audited SARAH 4.14.5 THDM, real parameters, two neutral backgrounds. Illustrative pipeline point, not a fitted 125 GeV Higgs benchmark.
notes: Scalar example inputs are read from the audited SPheno.m DefaultInputValues, never invented or fitted by an agent.
SM inputs define illustrative tree matching, not precision RG or pole-to-MSbar matching.
Scalar and longitudinal gauge self-energies use all source species in the leading high-temperature approximation.
The fixed phase-filter tolerance is a numerical convention, not a consequence of the symmetry.
All defaults are proposed until the exact contract is approved. Existing contracts are never overwritten.
